salidas.lista_consecuencia: Review the team’s proposal before confirming the closure date.
salidas.vacio: There are no proposed closures on this page.
salidas.error: We could not verify the result. Retry the same operation.
salidas.conflicto: The case has changed. Review the changes before continuing.
salidas.sin_permiso: Your session does not allow this action. Check your access.
salidas.no_encontrado: We could not find the case. Return to the inbox.
salidas.revisar_datos: Check the dates and details. Closure requires a pending team proposal.
salidas.segunda_persona: Closure and its record require a Coordination user other than the person who proposed closure.
salidas.bloqueo_spm: The SPM response is missing. To close without it, record the reason for the exception.
salidas.ayuda_texto: SPM is the Child Protection Service. Its response enables ordinary closure. If it has not responded, Coordination can authorise an exception with a written reason. Downloading the closure record registers an issue; the signature date and closure are confirmed separately. A team proposal must exist to close the case.
salidas.sin_salida: There is no referral to the SPM.
salidas.respuesta.inicio_desamparo_medid: Start of care proceedings or adoption of a measure is known
salidas.respuesta.medida_no_necesaria: The SPM considers the measure unnecessary
salidas.motivo_forzado: Reason for closure without an SPM response
salidas.forzado_anotado: Exception authorised and recorded in the audit trail. Closure is confirmed separately.
salidas.sin_finalizacion: The team has not saved completion details yet.
salidas.aviso_anexo: If Annex 11 or 12 is missing, closure is allowed with a warning.
salidas.fecha_cierre: Actual signature date of the closure record
salidas.motivo_acta_nuevo: Closure record reason written by Coordination (optional; applies when closure is confirmed)
salidas.acta_consecuencia: Downloading generates a Word document. Signature and closure are confirmed separately.
salidas.reapertura_consecuencia: A new episode opens and previous closures are preserved. If the SPM has still not responded, its closure restriction remains.
salidas.confirmar.respuesta: The response and its date will be recorded. Ordinary closure will be enabled.
salidas.confirmar.forzado: The reason will be audited. This authorisation allows closure without an SPM response; the case remains open until you confirm closure.
salidas.confirmar.cerrar: The case will close on the date entered. You must reopen it before editing it later. Downloading the record is a separate action.
salidas.confirmar.reabrir: A new episode will open with the reason entered. The history of the previous closure will be preserved.
salidas.hecho.forzado: Exception saved and audited. You can now confirm closure.
salidas.hecho.cerrar: Closure and date confirmed. You can download the closure record.
salidas.hecho.reabrir: Case reopened. The previous closure is preserved.
salidas.cierre_sin_anexo: Closure and date confirmed. Annex 11 or 12 has not been issued.
salidas.descargada: Closure record downloaded. It contains personal data: save it only where the Programme instructs you.
salidas.sin_propuesta: The team has not proposed closure yet. You can record the SPM response.
salidas.fecha_invalida: Enter a valid date up to today and on or after the previous step.
